title: Origin of Life
notes: Scientists believe that our planet, Earth, came into existence approximately four and a half billion years ago.
During its formation, the entire solar system emerged from the condensation of cosmic dust and gases (According to Dust and cloud hypothesis).
At its birth, it was incredibly hot that everything existed as gases, making it impossible for any form of life to exist.
Due to the extreme temperature, elements existed as individual atoms.
Intense heat broke the bonds apart quickly and atoms couldn't bond together.
These elements included carbon, silicon, oxygen, sulphur, chlorine, phosphorus, sodium, calcium, potassium, and iron.
Over time, Earth gradually cooled down, taking about 100 million years to transition into a molten core.
